status: candidate recipe; visual positioning is approximate and not final gameplay approval
coordinate_system: normalized within each visible character cutout after transparent crop; x right, y down
transform_convention: Weapon transform convention (canonical text: docs/assets-policy.md, section 戦闘人物と刀の合成): 1) coordinates are normalized to the transparent-cropped character image (x right, y down). 2) The weapon image is scaled so its height = weapon_height_ratio x character image height. 3) If flip_x is true it is mirrored horizontally (the weapon's handle anchor x becomes 1 - x). 4) It is rotated about its center by rotation_deg with canvas expand; PIL Image.rotate semantics: positive = counter-clockwise on screen. 5) The rotated image is placed so its handle anchor (handle_center_normalized from the weapon catalog, transformed with the image) lands on handle_target. 6) Layer order follows layer_order / pose_layers (weapon drawn above character). Union values: weapon_height_ratio, rotation_deg and handle_target are each either a scalar/object that applies to every structure, or an object keyed by structure {standing, wheelchair}; a missing structure key means the value applies to all structures.
